# 🛠️ Maintenance checklist

## Dependencies and tooling
- [ ] Review Dependabot alerts and update proposals.
- [ ] Review npm audit and CodeQL findings.
- [ ] Confirm Node runtime and lockfile consistency.
- [ ] Review GitHub Actions versions and permissions.

## Application behavior
- [ ] Run lint, tests, and build.
- [ ] Check JSON schema and duplicate IDs.
- [ ] Test search/filter and modal behavior.
- [ ] Check responsive and reduced-motion layouts.

## Privacy and content
- [ ] Review public JSON fields.
- [ ] Confirm records are synthetic/authorized.
- [ ] Review image URLs, usage rights, and availability.
- [ ] Check support reports for accidental sensitive data.

## Documentation and delivery
- [ ] Validate Markdown links and SVG assets.
- [ ] Update known issues and roadmap.
- [ ] Confirm project structure matches repository tree.
- [ ] Retain a known-good static build before deployment.
